{{short description|Result in linear algebra and projective geometry}}
In [[linear algebra]] and [[projective geometry]], '''Gerbaldi's theorem''', proved by {{harvs|txt|last=Gerbaldi|authorlink=Francesco Gerbaldi|year=1882}}, states that one can find six pairwise apolar [[linearly independent]] nondegenerate ternary [[quadratic form]]s.  These are permuted by the [[Valentiner group]].
